title: The Frost Weaving Course
summary: A course in weaving frost into ropes and webs and sheets so that a student can hold an opponent in place and cover a retreat.

title: A Course in Freezing Strikes
summary: A course in strikes that leave a freezing bite behind them and that drive a numbing cold deep into the struck limb.

title: The Second Primer of Rime Screens
summary: A second primer on building standing screens of rime that stop darts and spread a warning chill across the ground.

title: The Stillness and Sleet Handbook
summary: A handbook that pairs the calm of held cold with a driving burst of sleet so that the student can pass from waiting to striking.

title: The Handbook of Quick Cold
summary: A handbook of cold that is made in an instant and thrown or released at once and that covers a full round of fighting.

title: The Course of Tempered Chill
summary: A course on cold that is hardened and held in layers so that it guards the body and also mends the cold-struck.

title: The Cold-Binding Workbook
summary: A workbook of freezing binds and holds that fix an opponent's limbs and weapon in place and break them loose again.
